purpose: point-in-time S&P 500 universe for the paper (R6 / external point 5)

unresolved.detail: DOW -> DD: DD is already a member then
removed twice with no addition in between; kept as a member throughout
Michael Kors: not a member at this point and no current member or name matches

evidence_tickers.note: price evidence only: checks a registered amount against the price of the company that may have been handed out; downloaded into the same cache

large_moves.note: inventory of one-day moves in Yahoo's adjusted close as downloaded (before adjustment_corrections); no price was removed (the legacy |r| > 60% rule is not applied to this dataset)

adjustment_gaps.note: inventory of Yahoo's adjusted close as downloaded: days on which its return exceeds the split-adjusted close return by more than the threshold (special dividends and spin-offs, e.g. DHR 2016-07-05). Corrected in prices_adj.parquet and listed in adjustment_corrections.parquet unless --no-adjustment-corrections

adjustment_corrections.note: On the days of adjustment_gaps (the adjusted return exceeds the split-adjusted close return by more than the threshold) Yahoo's day return is replaced by a total return from the unadjusted close and the dividends and split ratios Yahoo registered for the day (cif.data.sp500_pit.correct_adjustment_artifacts); adjcorr-2 adds the verified spin-off days (verified_events). Every price before such a day is multiplied by scale_before, prices from the day on are Yahoo's; every other return is unchanged. adjustment_corrections.parquet lists the days; SP500PIT.prices_adj_yahoo() undoes them.

verified_events.note: The spin-off days registered in cif.data.sp500_events: the terms of the transaction as the company filed them (sources, record and distribution dates in corporate_action_checks.json) give the holder's total return from the as-traded closes of the parent and of the distributed companies; a Yahoo series or a documented price per company; every price check must hold or the build stops. Applied after the gap rule by the same scale_before mechanism.

uncorrected_dividend_days.note: dividend days below the threshold, left to Yahoo: |Yahoo return - (Close + D)/Close(t-1) + 1|

pseudo_split_days_not_corrected.note: ratios that are no share-count ratios, on days that adjustment_gaps does not list because no dividend is registered. If the ratio books a spin-off, Yahoo's Close return there is the ratio times the total return (return_if_value_ratio, unverified). Listed in pseudo_split_days.parquet; the days of the verified events are corrected (marked so), the others are not changed
